card.name: Words introducing a purpose or indication
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "to" and "of" that introduce a purpose or use, after nouns like treatment, prevention, management, or verbs like want. Also appears after "or" in lists of uses.

modes.label: Indication headings
modes.description: "of" after treatment, prevention or management in lists of what a drug is used for.
modes.example: 2 mg/kg once daily (maximum daily dose 100 mg) Treatment<< of>> Esophageal Candidiasis 3

modes.label: Purpose "to" or "for"
modes.description: "to" or "for" after "or" or after want/wanted, introducing an aim or purpose.
modes.example: Author’s use fragments all the time for emphasis or<< to>> imitate speech.

card.writes: Suppresses a few odd tokens and promotes "patch"-type words, with no clear link to the context.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "to" and "of" that lead into a purpose or use, such as "treatment of" a condition.
